steps.label: clone llama.cpp (pinned v0.4.1)
steps.cmd: cd ~ && rm -rf llama.cpp && git clone --depth=1 --branch v0.4.1 https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp llama.cpp

steps.label: cmake build ggml static libs
steps.cmd: cd ~/llama.cpp && cmake --build build -j$(nproc) --target ggml ggml-base ggml-cpu

llama.cpp._comment: Kernel dataset build (ggml static libs only). Pinned to a release tag so every solution/baseline trace across a sweep sees the same ggml; bump deliberately and re-collect baselines.

llama.cpp-e2e._comment: End-to-end build for scripts/e2e: full llama.cpp tools (llama-bench, llama-cli, llama-perplexity) at the same pin, in a separate tree so the kernel-dataset build above is untouched, plus the Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M GGUF. 'stock' = upstream CPU backend as shipped (the baseline tokens/s); scripts/e2e/build_agent_llamacpp.sh derives the 'agent' build (override hook applied) from this tree.

steps.label: clone llama.cpp (pinned v0.4.1) for e2e
steps.cmd: cd ~ && rm -rf llama.cpp-e2e && git clone --depth=1 --branch v0.4.1 https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp llama.cpp-e2e

steps.label: cmake configure stock build (cpu-only, tools on)
cmake build stock llama-bench/llama-cli/llama-perplexity
steps.cmd: cd ~/llama.cpp-e2e && cmake --build build-stock -j$(nproc) --target llama-bench llama-cli llama-perplexity

steps.label: fetch Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M gguf (unsloth, 2.74 GB)
steps.cmd: mkdir -p ~/models && cd ~/models && test -f Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf || curl -sSL -o Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf.part https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.5-4B-GGUF/resolve/main/Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf && mv -f Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf.part Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf; ls -la ~/models
